ratio_27b_over_9b.note: ratio = 27B seconds per record / 9B seconds per record, both reference (`ref`, native, batch 1), same records; 'pooled' weights by records. The 27B has no clinc150 yet, so the pooled ratio excludes it.

like_for_like_full_sets.note: full-set configs only (ref, q8_0, q4_k_m, fp8, nvfp4, bf16-srv, gguf-bf16, ref-r2); restricted to the sets where every one has an END line; speed_vs_ref = ref s/record divided by the config's

meta.pooled_note: Public pooled mean = the n-weighted mean of the per-set mean_ms over the public sets. A pooled p50 cannot be derived from per-set p50s, so `median_of_set_p50_ms` is the median of the per-set p50s (an unweighted median over sets, not the p50 of the pooled requests). Private sets are pooled the same way and appear only as that aggregate.
meta.ratio_note: `ratio_27b_over_9b[config]` = clef mean_ms / clef-flash mean_ms of the same config (overall mean_ms, all 16 sets). `mean_ms_over_ref` = the config's overall mean_ms / the same model's `ref` overall mean_ms (above 1 is slower than ref).
meta.note: isolated latency: batch size 1, one request in flight, 300 sampled records per set, per-request milliseconds. Timing differs by engine: vLLM and llama.cpp configs are an HTTP round trip to localhost (server-side tokenisation included); ref and ref-r2 are in-process (encode, collate, forward, cuda sync, no HTTP). ref-r2 is an alias of ref, not a second measurement. Peak memory is measured differently per engine (see peak_memory_source).
